## How your plan works

Most mobile observability tools leave you guessing with charges for sessions, crash limits, or usage spikes. Luciq keeps it simple with one transparent plan that scales only as your app succeeds.

![Daily active users icon](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/6898c7bad2e3e342ea1c43bd/68d0fe42362b361b09eb945a_Daily%20Active%20Users.svg)

Daily Active Users

We charge only for users. Not logs, sessions, or traces. So you're free to collect all the data you need.

![Observability platform icon](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/6898c7bad2e3e342ea1c43bd/68d0fe4293c81840d8c4c641_Observability%20Platform.svg)

Observability Platform

All-in-one, built for mobile products covering the full lifecycle, from testing to production monitoring.

![Member seats icon](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/6898c7bad2e3e342ea1c43bd/68d0fe42a2162387add3bc83_Member%20Seats.svg)

Member Seats

Flexible seats as your team grows. Add seats anytime.  Only pay for who needs access.

## FAQs

How does Luciq calculate DAU?

Luciq takes the higher value between third-party app store data and first-party SDK telemetry. We review your rolling 6-month average usage twice a year.

What happens if I exceed my usage limits?

Luciq looks at your average usage over time, not just daily spikes. We price by DAU tiers to provide more price consistency. If your average DAU consistently exceeds your current tier we’ll reach out to discuss moving to the next tier.

What hosting options are available?

We have a global footprint. We have options to pin your data in geographies across the globe.

What support is included in the plan?

All Enterprise plans include standard technical support with pre-defined SLAs. Advanced support options include named contacts, enhanced SLAs and 24/7 coverage.

Can I try Luciq without purchasing?

Yes. You can [request a demo](https://www.luciq.ai/request-demo), and our team will get in touch to walk you through the product, and if needed enable a limited technical POC environment.
